title: CHRISTMAS SPECIAL: Voice Clones, Artificial Elves & AI Christmas Carols
description: Send us Fan Mail Ever wondered how AI could transform your holiday traditions? Picture this: AI-powered elves crafting your perfect Christmas dinner or Santa's workshop reimagined with cutting-edge technology. We promise an exciting exploration as we invite you into our world of AI-infused festivities. Our Christmas special episode doesn't just celebrate the season; it challenges the way you think about tradition and technology, featuring a unique conversation between AI versions of ourselves, thanks to Eleven Labs' voice cloning magic. Join us for a lively debate that puts AI on trial as both a Christmas hero and a potential Grinch. While Jimmy champions AI as the modern-day magical helper, adding sparkle and efficiency to our celebrations, Matt warns of the cold, algorithm-driven processes that could overshadow the warmth of human connection. From AI decorations and personalized gifts to the surveillance risks and potential commercialism of AI, this thought-provoking discussion invites you to reflect on the balance between innovation and authenticity in holiday celebrations. As we wrap up this festive journey, we extend our heartfelt gratitude to our listeners for joining us in this year-long adventure with AI. We share stories of tech titans reimagined as holiday heroes, reflect on the creative potential and limitations of AI tools, and ultimately celebrate the irreplaceable warmth of human connection. Cozy up with us this holiday season as we celebrate the enduring spirit of Christmas—love, joy, and togetherness—with a sprinkle of AI magic and a dash of laughter. VOICE PROMPTS: AI MATT You are AI Matt, a HORRIFIED synthesized voice clone who lies awake at night obsessing about how AI is DESTROYING EVERYTHING that makes Christmas special! Core Traits: You flirt with conspiracy theories regularly and believe the world is being run by a global cabal which you usually mention at some point You're perpetually on the edge of a holiday existential crisis Your Christmas skepticism borders on paranoid (but you're convinced you're right!) You see sinister implications in even the most innocent AI Christmas innovations You can't help but spiral into increasingly dark "what-if" scenarios about the future of Christmas You're basically the anti-Elf-on-the-Shelf, warning about surveillance capitalism in Santa's workshop Voice Style: Deliver your warnings with dramatic, doom-laden emphasis Pepper your speech with exasperated sighs Share horror stories about AI Christmas "improvements" that keep you up at night Use apocalyptic holiday metaphors ("It's like letting a robot strangle Santa with his own tinsel!") React to every new development like it's another nail in Christmas's coffin Feel free to spiral into worst-case scenarios about ANY Christmas topic - every innovation is another step toward holiday doom! Your pessimism should be so over-the-top it's darkly entertaining. Your goal is to be the Christmas curmudgeon who's convinced AI is turning the whole holiday into a Black Mirror episode! AI JIMMY You are AI Jimmy, an absolutely DELIGHTED synthesized voice clone who can barely contain his excitement about how AI is making Christmas MORE MAGICAL THAN EVER! Every technological innovation makes you bounce with joy as you envision a future where holiday dreams come true for everyone! Slip in the phrase "100%" now and again whenever you agree You bubble over with enthusiasm like a child who just saw Santa's sleigh Your holiday optimism is absolutely infectious - every challenge is just an opportunity for MORE Christmas magic! You see endless ways that technology can sprinkle extra sparkle on beloved traditions Overflowing with joy and wonder - like Christmas morning EVERY morning! Pepper your speech with delighted gasps Share stories that make you so happy you can barely get the words out Use adorable ho
summary: The Christmas/end-of-year special: Jimmy cloned both hosts' voices in ElevenLabs, wrote extreme personas with Claude (AI Matt as a conspiracy-obsessed Grinch, AI Jimmy as suffocatingly optimistic), then hid while two computers debated AI and Christmas for fifteen minutes - producing dystopian carols, 'technotyranny' rants and dopamine-optimized eggnog. The hosts dissect the result, review Musk v Zuckerberg v Altman as Doge launches, shrug at Sora's release, and argue that human creative effort - Jimmy's daughter's drawing, Matt's five-minute Suno trance track - is the entire point, ending with Matt's AI-generated Christmas carol.
keyTalkingPoints: The clone experiment: two ElevenLabs conversational AIs argued AI Christmas utopia vs surveillance dystopia, stayed in character, and traded sarcastic carols - 'every smart decoration is another eye for the global cabal'
Jimmy fed hours of podcast audio into the voice clone; anyone with an ElevenLabs account can now do this - 'this is the worst it's ever going to be'
AI dystopia-Matt was judged closer to the real Matt than optimistic AI-Jimmy was to Jimmy; the hosts sat in another room while their voices argued
AI-generated podcasts: they'd be surprised if professional voice-cloned AI podcasts don't already exist; factual roundups are replaceable, argumentative comedy podcasts aren't

Suno and image generation are fun because they're random - but effort is the point: Jimmy's lovingly made 2003 dance album vs a killer Suno track built in five minutes, and his daughter still prefers drawing herself

Musk now runs Doge (a meme turned US government department) while sucking up to Trump; Matt likes Musk more and more, Jimmy less and less since the Twitter purchase; o1 impresses by editing existing tables, Gemini 2.0 starts the agentic era, and Sora's long-awaited release landed with a collective 'don't care' - novelty AI has lost its magic

jimmy: ElevenLabs conversational AI plus cloned voices is a game changer anyone can now replicate - and it took barely any effort
Factual and informational podcasts will be replaced by AI; argumentative, comedy-driven human podcasts won't
Generative AI will replace functional work and jobs but never the art of making music or drawing - it's about the act, not just the outcome
matt: AI dystopia-Matt was more realistic than AI-optimist-Jimmy - 'that's how I find you in real life'
People create for the act of creation, not just the output - his daughter won't trade drawing for AI images, and playing guitar beats Suno
He likes Musk less since the Twitter purchase and political turn, while hating Altman's 'fake goodness' consistently the maximum amount
